notes: Korgus Sampler: slučka a skenovanie (ako v Inspirii), zoom kolieskom myši na zvuku. Skenovanie teraz drží výšku podľa tónov (Sampler aj Inspiria), zoom aj v editore samplu Inspirie. Gombíky, posuvníky a prepínače bez guľatých prvkov.
notes_en: Korgus Sampler: loop and scanning (as in Inspiria), mouse-wheel zoom on the sound. Scanning now keeps the pitch with the notes (Sampler and Inspiria), zoom also in the Inspiria sample editor. Knobs, sliders and toggles without round elements.
